title: RSI Break Timer Miss Rate
dataSources: Pomodoro focus sessions (`pomofocus:session`), desk position logs (`upliftdesk:desk`), Elgato Key Light usage (`elgato:keylight`), calendar meetings (`calendar:event`), and Stretchly breaks (`stretchly:break`).
app: Pomofocus sessions, Uplift desk position logs, Elgato Key Light telemetry, Stretchly break reminders, and meeting calendar events sent to Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=stretchly:break
| eval missed=if(break_outcome="missed",1,0)
| stats sum(missed) as missed_breaks, count as total_breaks by day_of_week
| eval missed_pct=round(100*missed_breaks/total_breaks,1)
| sort - missed_pct
description: Measures how often scheduled microbreaks are skipped, grouped by day of week.
value: Missed breaks are an early RSI signal because they usually rise long before pain forces a change.
implementation: Forward Stretchly reminder outcomes into Splunk and trend the share of missed breaks over time.
visualization: Bar chart of missed-break percentage by weekday.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks which days you keep ignoring the little breaks that protect your hands, shoulders, and eyes.
